+def _get_units_from_attrs(var) -> str:
+    """Extracts and formats the unit/s from a variable's attributes."""
+    units = " "
+    if var.attrs.get("units") is not None:
+        units = " [{}] ".format(str(var.attrs["units"]))
+    elif var.attrs.get("unit") is not None:
+        units = " [{}] ".format(str(var.attrs["unit"]))
+    return units
+
